description: This file defines a React component for an interactive mind map interface, handling state management, data fetching, user interactions, and rendering of the mind map and associated UI elements.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between min and max values to constrain zoom levels.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Returns default filter settings for the mind map filters.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Returns the default view state for the mind map, including position, zoom, filters, and selection.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Converts an arbitrary object into a safe, validated MindmapViewState with defaults.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Retrieves a user identifier for personalization, fallback to 'anonymous'.
